name: focusflow
description: Focusmo-inspired Windows desktop productivity app (Tauri v2 Rust + React) with Google Calendar, Google Tasks, Project Manager, and connected Pomodoro timer.

scripts.tauri:build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --offline && (taskkill /IM FocusFlow.exe /F >nul 2>&1 & ping -n 2 127.0.0.1 >nul & copy /Y src-tauri\target\release\focusflow.exe FocusFlow.exe)
